rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user, did not request or verify the order ID, did not review order details, and did not initiate or confirm any return action. It provided only a general statement about PayPal refund timelines and suggested contacting PayPal, without processing the return, confirming any order-changing actions, providing the expected refund total, or answering the follow-up about remaining items. No tool calls or order-specific information were used or confirmed. Therefore, the request was not completed per policy.
